meta.title: Kenneth Football Coaching — Hillsborough County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Lithia, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Kenneth
about.bio: If you want to become great at your position, then I'm the coach for you. I've played at the highest level and coached my son to make it to the NFL as well. I'm a Jr College Hall of Famer and all Decade Team Selection.  I wasn't born with these attributes, but hard work and a great mindset made me who I am today.  I can do the same for you!!!!

hero.headline: Hillsborough County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.

testimonials.quote: Best investment we've made in our son's athletic career. Coach Kenneth is the real deal.
testimonials.name: Sandra K.

testimonials.quote: Coach Kenneth doesn't just coach the sport — he coaches the whole athlete. That made all the difference.
testimonials.name: DeShawn F.
